channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Kenrich Williams | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Kenrich Williams from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Alex Caruso on Isaiah Hartenstein, Kenrich Williams
item.description:
“I’m the oldest guy on the team—me and Kenrich [Williams]. Hart’s [Isaiah Hartenstein] only 26,”

Alex Caruso on Isaiah Hartenstein, Kenrich Williams, Mar 6, 2025. Source: Clutch Points.

item.title: Mitch Johnson on Kenrich Williams, Julian Champagnie
item.description:
Spurs coach Mitch Johnson said.

“I don't really know who was at fault, to be honest. But it just looked like that was what initiated it. And then there was the response on both ends. [It] just looked like Kenrich Williams was being aggressive, and Julian was opening up. I don't know if that's an offensive foul now. I don't know where that line is of what space you're allowed.”

Mitch Johnson on Kenrich Williams, Julian Champagnie, Mar 3, 2025. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Mark Daigneault on Kenrich Williams
item.description:
Clemente Almanza:Mark Daigneault on Kenrich Williams:

“I was hoping to see exactly what I saw... That game was a brawl and he's a brawler.”

Mark Daigneault on Kenrich Williams, May 14, 2024. Source: Twitter @CAlmanza1007.

item.title: Mark Daigneault on Kenrich Williams
item.description:
Brandon Rahbar:Mark Daigneault on Kenrich Williams:

“He’s got great soul. He just has that X factor. Just the integrity of that person is impressive. You can’t put a price tag on the impact he has on the group.”

Mark Daigneault on Kenrich Williams, Jan 9, 2023. Source: Twitter @BrandonRahbar.

item.title: Al Horford on Kenrich Williams
item.description:
Al Horford on Kenrich Williams' big night:

“I've been talking about KRich since I got here. He impressed me early on. He's mature beyond his years. Whatever you need from him, he does it all.”

Al Horford on Kenrich Williams, Feb 11, 2021. Source: Twitter @BrandonRahbar.
